resources.string: Required. \"%1$s\" shows the cursor, taps, scrolls and does back, home and volume. It can\'t read your screen.

\"%1$s\" can read the text field you\'re typing in, so your computer can type, copy and paste there, and it notices when you copy so the text is sent automatically. Banking and UPI apps may warn about accessibility services that read the screen: switch it off while paying. Without it, remote control still works and the bubble sends your clipboard.

Service keeps turning off? On vivo / iQOO phones the system closes background apps and Android then switches their accessibility services off. In Settings › Battery › Background power consumption management, allow high background power consumption for AirBridge, and lock AirBridge in Recents (swipe its card down or tap the lock). Menu names differ between OriginOS / Funtouch versions.

Service keeps turning off? Some phones close background apps, and Android then switches their accessibility services off. Set AirBridge\'s battery use to unrestricted and lock it in Recents if your phone offers that.
